name: @w6w-apps/float
description: Manage people, projects, allocations, time off, milestones, clients, statuses and logged time in Float — the resource scheduling and team capacity planning tool.

w6w.longDescription:
Float is resource scheduling and team capacity planning software: who is working on what, when, and how much room is left before someone is overbooked.

This app covers Float's core scheduling objects over its REST API v3 — People (the team roster), Projects and Clients (what work belongs to), Allocations (the schedule itself, called `tasks` in the API), Time Off, Milestones, Statuses (short one-off notes like 'Travelling' or 'Sick'), and Logged Time (actual hours worked, distinct from the scheduled allocation). Every action does the CRUD the vendor documents for that resource — list, get, create, update, delete where Float exposes each.

Two Float quirks a workflow needs to know about, both handled here rather than left for the next step to discover: `logged-time` create answers `200` with an array of entries (every other create answers `201` with one object), and its own ID is a string, not the integer every other Float ID uses; and `status` create/update answer a `{status: [...]}` wrapper because creating a status that overlaps an existing one for that person silently deletes the old one and returns both.
